name: Error Acknowledgment
sourceRefs: cosyte/ncpdp src/script/response.ts (ResponseFields, shared verbatim with Status/Verify -- dispositionOf() maps "Error" to "error" fail-safe, never coerced to a success) -- cross-confirmed against usnistgov/tcamt-2's SCRIPT_XML_10_6.xsd own <Error> element (Code with pattern 600|601|602|900, DescriptionCode 0..10, Description 0..1). A negative acknowledgment of a prior transaction, matching X12 999's own IK5/AK9 rejection-code precedent -- engine support without a FHIR mapping (a transport-layer nack has no natural FHIR resource analogue).
